title: Seoul says no decision on Alaska gas investment announced by Trump

blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — South Korea has agreed to invest billions of dollars in US energy projects, both governments said, but Seoul expressed regret on Thursday that Washington’s announcement “went beyond what had been agreed upon.” Seoul had previously agreed to invest $350 billion in the United States and increase purchases of American energy under a July 2025 trade deal that set 15 percent tariffs on imports from the East Asian nation.
